## Changes

Describe what changed and why. Link the related issue, if applicable.

## Testing

Describe the environment, commands and results. Note any existing failures, new failures or tests not run. For performance changes, include comparable before/after results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the diff has been reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant tests were run, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.
- [ ] No proprietary game data, generated game code, private captures or credentials are included.
- [ ] Original attribution and applicable licensing notices are preserved.
